measuredBy: All fifteen proof obligations were independently scored from the current participant-facing PDF bytes, source bytes, production field maps, participant instructions, packet/track manifests, rendered-artifact records, actual-write records, and family-focused completeness output. SHA-256 and byte lengths were recomputed. PDF page counts were independently counted. independence: CODEX-CS2-VF30 built and repaired none of these families and inherited no verdict. No overlay, source, build script, route, central state, or ledger file was edited.
grantsNothing: An independent pass proves packet completeness only. It is not visual approval, counsel approval, live approval, or commercial authority. A failure is a verdict and repair assignment, never a repair by this lane.
workerNote: Every claim assertion returned CLAIM_OK before that family was read. All seven family-focused completeness runs returned PASS_COMPLETE and all nine counters independently zero.
